notes: APP_URL is required and drives every link, asset and redirect; domain changes must rewrite it.
APP_KEY is a stored 32-byte Laravel encryption key, base64-encoded in compose. Regenerating it loses sessions and encrypted settings.
The linuxserver image keeps configuration, uploads and generated files in /config. MariaDB has its own volume and separate root and application passwords.
Sign in with the documented default account, then change its password immediately.
